title: 🔆🔅Tehran - September 16 - Kioumars Heidari, Deputy Chief of Staff of Iran Armed Forces made remarks.
text:
🔆🔅Tehran - September 16 - Kioumars Heidari, Deputy Chief of Staff of Iran Armed Forces made remarks."

""
"SOT1, Kioumars Heidari, Deputy Chief of Staff of Iran Armed Forces (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:34): "Today we are the victors of the field. The enemy, with all its commotion and effort, and after 47 years of boasting and preparation, came heavily—seeking, in its own words, to overturn the system of the Islamic Republic of Iran in a few short days. But what a vain delusion; today, our armed forces are the ones directing the scene of the war.""

"SOT2, Kioumars Heidari, Deputy Chief of Staff of Iran Armed Forces (Farsi) (00:35 - 00:55): "When we say we are fighting America, I mean we sometimes actually forget that we are dealing with an America that many countries are afraid to even mention, let alone engage with; and there is the Zionist regime, with regional countries acting as its servants and under its control.""

"SOT3, Kioumars Heidari, Deputy Chief of Staff of Iran Armed Forces (Farsi) (00:56 - 01:12): "Today, in response to every insolent move by the enemy, we are raining down a multitude of missiles on that region, leaving the enemy astonished; the authority of our armed forces is truly exemplary.""

"SOT4, Kioumars Heidari, Deputy Chief of Staff of Iran Armed Forces (Farsi) (01:13 - 01:47): "I believe Americans have two inevitable destinies in this region. If they continue the war, a large number of their forces will certainly return to their country in the same way they have been killed to date, and, God willing, another large group of them will sink to the bottom of the region's waters.""

"SOT5, Kioumars Heidari, Deputy Chief of Staff of Iran Armed Forces (Farsi) (01:48 - 02:27): "Our missiles targeted their heavy aircraft carriers and their accompanying frigates, attacked them, and inflicted serious damage upon them, which led to two desperate enemy reactions. First, they carried out movements in the Persian Gulf region, and second, they desperately and cowardly tried to increase their distance from us to 500 kilometers.
